This distribution embeds a subset of Homebrew CPython 3.14.8_3 and its standard library using PyInstaller 6.22.3.
Native load commands and code signatures are adjusted for app-bundle packaging; all inspected native code sections match their recorded input binaries.
Homebrew modifies sysconfig and generates installation-specific _sysconfigdata. Exact installed versions and the Homebrew build formula are retained as source evidence.
Original CPython license terms and embedded-code notices remain applicable.
